claims.statement: CSIRE makes contract, technical, consumption, and production data available to electricity users, including measurements at up to 15-minute resolution for compatible remote meters.

The CSIRE portal allows a data owner to grant access to other entities and provides CSV or PDF exports for selected data, creating at least a consented-file MVP path before any direct system integration.
Hypothesis: embedded load-shape analysis will increase quote credibility and reduce manual sizing enough for wholesalers or installer CRMs to subsidise it as a conversion tool.

contrary_evidence: CSIRE operator onboarding is staged through October 2026, so coverage and data completeness are not yet uniform.
The customer portal already supports data viewing and export, so the product must own recommendation quality and quote conversion rather than mere access.

economics.acquisition_route: Start with the family company for outcome calibration, then integrate once with a wholesaler or vertical CRM that already reaches installers
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 25 platforms at 100000 PLN ARR plus usage revenue could exceed 3.5 million PLN ARR in years 5-7; at 35% EBITDA and 6x EBITDA with 80% ownership, founder equity would approach 5.9 million PLN, excluding any already-capitalised retained earnings
economics.founder_time: 12-20 hours weekly for MVP and calibration, then 6-10 hours weekly if support and integration are standardised
economics.gross_margin_basis: Batch time-series modelling and report generation should produce 85-93% gross margin before partner support
economics.payback: A partner should recover fees from one incremental equipment sale; target founder CAC payback under 6 months
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 20-60 PLN per analysis, 300-700 PLN monthly installer plans, or 50000-150000 PLN annual platform contracts
economics.retention_or_repeat: Partners repeat the analysis on every quote and retain calibration history across seasons and installed systems

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Consented anonymised load shapes linked to equipment choices and realised outcomes calibrate local recommendation models
fingerprint.customer: Solar, battery, heat-pump, tariff, and energy-management sellers serving Polish homes and small businesses
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Embedded in equipment distributor portals, installer CRMs, tariff comparison flows, and finance applications
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Consent-based load-shape ingestion and sizing API with per-analysis and platform pricing
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Wholesaler, CRM, or installer pays per analysed metering point or successful quote generated
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A seller needs to size equipment and substantiate expected savings while preparing a customer quote

founder_fit: Excellent match for data science, Polish energy access, the family installer as a bounded pilot, and an embedded product model that avoids constant consumer sales. The founder must keep recommendations probabilistic and contractually prevent guaranteed-savings claims.
risks: Energy data are sensitive personal data in practice and require strict consent, minimisation, and deletion controls.
Wholesalers may copy a simple calculator unless the outcome dataset compounds quickly.
Savings estimates can be mis-sold as guarantees by downstream installers.

structure.control_point: The equipment sizing and savings recommendation rendered inside the seller's quote
structure.critical_dependency: Scalable lawful consent to sufficiently granular CSIRE data and evidence that better recommendations lift partner economics

thesis: Build a consent-based CSIRE data-to-recommendation API that lets solar, battery, heat-pump, and energy-tariff sellers generate an evidence-backed system size and savings range inside their existing quote. Distribution comes from equipment wholesalers and installer CRMs; the end customer supplies or authorises their own energy data.
title: FlexSignal Quote API
uncertainties: It is not established which commercial users can obtain scalable consented B2B access and under what contract.
Actual savings-prediction lift versus installer rules of thumb needs a blinded quote experiment.
Tariff, weather, equipment, and household-behaviour assumptions may dominate meter-data precision.
